verdicts.A_native_runtime: not_run_in_this_lane; product busy state remains unverified

finding.summary: The replay verifies button identity and visibility only at MutationObserver delivery. It can count a busy transition that occurred while that same button was outside the active Scrape pane or hidden, after the button returns idle to its original visible position before delivery.
finding.source: tests/browser/scrape-busy-observer.mjs: sample() resolves the current button, then replays all records targeting that node using current button.contains(record.target); overlap is not gated by historical pane ownership or visibility.
minimal_reproduction_foreign: Arm the observer on the unique visible Capture button in the active Scrape pane.
Within one JavaScript turn, move that button into a foreign pane; set disabled=true and text=Capturing…; set disabled=false and text=Capture; move it back into the active Scrape pane.
Allow MutationObserver delivery and read the state. Actual owned visible busy overlap never occurred, but observed=true, text=Capturing…, overlappingMutationState=true, disabledSamples=0.
minimal_reproduction_hidden: Arm the observer on the unique visible Capture button in the active Scrape pane.
Within one JavaScript turn, hide the button with display:none; set disabled=true and text=Capturing…; set disabled=false and text=Capture; show it again.
Allow MutationObserver delivery and read the state. Actual visible busy overlap never occurred, but observed=true, text=Capturing…, overlappingMutationState=true, disabledSamples=0.
finding.repair_direction: Reconstruct ownership and visibility at the same ordered transition as disabled and label, or decline a record-only verdict when those states changed during the callback batch. Preserve the strict requirement for one owned visible button simultaneously disabled with the correct busy label.

checks.independent_dom_probes: Two inline happy-dom probes against the committed observer both returned false-positive observed=true with overlappingMutationState=true.
checks.product_change: None in reviewed commit; observer and unit tests only.
checks.criterion_change: No explicit relaxation; defect is a false-positive implementation of the strict criterion.
checks.native_browser_release: Not run by this source-only peer lane.

limits: This report demonstrates an oracle defect, not that the product did or did not render a busy state in a real browser.
The existing unit cases cover same-button positive and nonoverlap transitions; they do not cover ownership or visibility changes within one MutationObserver batch.
The hosted run recorded in the causal receipt predates this observer and cannot validate its native behavior.
